item.text: The ACT Integrity Commission considered a corruption complaint about the government’s acquisition of nine rural properties west of Canberra.
item.support: the ACT Land Development Agency had acquired nine rural properties

item.text: It examined the acquisitions against the land acquisition policy framework and considered earlier audit and parliamentary scrutiny.
item.support: against the requirements set out in the Planning and Development (Land Acquisition Policy Framework) Direction 2014

item.text: The Commission dismissed the complaint, concluding that other Territory laws had already dealt appropriately with the subject and further action was unjustified.
item.support: the subject matter has already been appropriately dealt with under other laws in force in the Territory
